# Tailrocks: macOS Design Review

`tailrocks-macos-design-review` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-macos-design-review)

Score an existing macOS screen, window, or prototype against the native-design and Liquid Glass contract. Read-only toward the subject; never fixes, blesses, captures, or systematizes.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-macos-design-review` …

Arguments: `[preliminary|acceptance] <screen, window, or prototype package>`
